# fjordrun_workflows (Data Source)

A team's workflows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_workflows" "all" {
  team_id = var.team_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `workflows` (Attributes List) The workflows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflows))

<a id="nestedatt--workflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workflows`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `definition` (String) The graph, as a JSON document.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Workflow ID.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether triggers start runs.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.
- `triggers` (Attributes List) What starts it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflows--triggers))
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.

<a id="nestedatt--workflows--triggers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workflows.triggers`

Read-Only:

- `cron` (String) Cron expression.
- `type` (String) `manual`, `cron`, `webhook` or `api`.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) URL that starts a run; it contains a secret.
